title: 第十一章 氪命第十二章 等不及了
content_zh:
消耗寿元换领悟力。
别人几个月才能入门的东西，他烧上几年寿命，一天给你搞定。
苏阎把玉简合上，走到藏书阁门口。
老人还是那个姿势，窝在躺椅上翻书，头都没抬。
“挑好了？”
“这个。”苏阎把玉简放在老人面前的矮桌上。
老人斜眼一扫，看到是《太虚龙象拳》，眉毛抖了一下。
“这玩意儿放了得有七八年了，你是第一个拿它的。”老人把道书合上，意味不明地打量了苏阎两眼，“之前有个外门弟子也挑过这门拳法，练了不到半个月，两条胳膊从肘关节往下全碎了。后来被人抬去了执法堂，用两百点贡献换了对残废手臂的修复。”
“你想好了？”
“想好了。”
老人摇了摇头，不再多说，手指在令牌上一抹，五十点贡献清零。
苏阎见此，皱了皱眉，按理而言兑换了功法后，自己应该还剩一点贡献点的。
“多的那一贡献点作为我的报酬。”
听此，苏阎心中吐槽，这还真是符合魔门的作风。
随后老人摆了摆手，“拿走吧。”
苏阎收好玉简和令牌，转身往外走。
身后传来老人翻书页的声音，慢吞吞的，夹杂着一句像自言自语的话。
“年轻人，不怕死是好事。但别死得太早，死早了可就什么都没了。”
苏阎没应声，脚步不停，迈出了藏书阁的门槛。
……

回到洞府，石门打开的一瞬，林安从石床上弹起来，看到是苏阎后，整个人才软回去。
“回来了……”
苏阎“嗯”了一声，坐上石床，掏出那枚灰色玉简。
五十点贡献，一个子儿不剩了。
令牌余额：0。
这下可真的算是身无分文了。
但苏阎一点都不慌。
钱这东西，从来都是从别人口袋里掏的。
山羊胡和他那两个跟班，就是现成的钱袋子。
关键是速度。
他得赶在那三人第二次上门之前，把《太虚龙象拳》练到能杀人的程度。
苏阎将神念沉入玉简，《太虚龙象拳》的全篇口诀和运功路线在脑海中铺展开来，一尊仰天咆哮的太古蛮牛图腾浮现在他的脑海中。
“天行健，君子以自强不息；地势坤，君子以厚德载物。
上古有青牛，负天尊出函谷，一步一劫，步步生莲。
修道者，先学牛。
牛者，不言不语，不争不抢。低头是田垄，抬头是青天。
content_en:
Spend your lifespan in exchange for comprehension.
What it takes others months to get started with, he spent several years to do for you in one day.
Su Yan closed the jade slip and walked to the door of the library.
The old man was still in the same position, sitting on the recliner and reading a book without raising his head.
"Have you chosen?"
"This." Su Yan placed the jade slip on the low table in front of the old man.
The old man glanced sideways and saw "Taixu Dragon Elephant Fist", and his eyebrows twitched.
"This thing has been lying around for seven or eight years, and you are the first to take it." The old man closed the Taoist book and looked at Su Yan with unknown meaning. "An outer disciple also picked up this boxing method before. After practicing for less than half a month, both arms were completely broken from the elbow joint down. Later, he was carried to the Law Enforcement Hall, and he used 200 points to repair the disabled arms."
"Have you thought about it?"
"Think about it."
The old man shook his head, said no more, touched the token with his finger, and the fifty-point contribution was cleared.
Seeing this, Su Yan frowned. Logically speaking, after exchanging the skills, he should still have some contribution points left.
"The extra contribution points will be my reward."
After hearing this, Su Yan complained in his heart, this is really in line with the style of the Demon Sect.
Then the old man waved his hand and said, "Take it away."
Su Yan put away the jade slip and token, turned around and walked out.
The sound of the old man turning the pages of a book came from behind, slowly, mixed with a sentence that sounded like he was talking to himself.
"Young people, it's a good thing not to be afraid of death. But don't die too early. If you die too early, there will be nothing."
Su Yan did not respond, but kept walking and stepped out of the threshold of the library.
…
Back in the cave, the moment the stone door opened, Lin An jumped up from the stone bed. Only when he saw that it was Su Yan, did his whole body soften.
"Back..."
Su Yan said "hmm", sat on the stone bed, and took out the gray jade slip.
Fifty points of contribution, not a penny left.
Token balance: 0.
Now I am really penniless.
But Su Yan didn't panic at all.
Money is always taken from other people's pockets.
Goatee and his two followers are ready-made money bags.
The key is speed.
He had to practice "Taixu Dragon Elephant Fist" to the point where he could kill people before those three people came to visit him for the second time.
Su Yan sinks his spiritual thoughts into the jade slip, and the entire formula and movement route of "Taixu Dragon Elephant Fist" unfolds in his mind, and an ancient bull totem roaring up to the sky appears in his mind.
"When the sky is healthy, a gentleman will strive to strengthen himself; when the terrain is weak, a gentleman will be virtuous.
In ancient times, there was a green bull that carried the Heavenly Lord out of Han Valley. Every step of the way, lotuses sprouted from it.
Those who want to practice Taoism must first learn from others.
Those who are bulls don't say anything, don't fight or grab. Looking down is the fields, looking up is the sky.
